column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline scan rules for the DAST job (.github/workflows/dast.yml).
# Tab-separated: <alertId>
#   action = IGNORE  — accepted / not applicable, never fails the scan
#            WARN     — reported, does not fail the scan (default for anything not listed)
#            FAIL     — reported and fails the scan
#   url-regex — omit (empty 3rd column) to apply to every URL; otherwise a Python
#               regex matched against the finding's URL
# Posture: BLOCKING (fail-action: true in dast.yml) — every finding below has been
# judged and accepted; a NEW un-IGNOREd WARN/FAIL now fails the scan. Re-triage this
# file whenever a new phase widens the scan (authenticated pages, the Umbraco hosts).
# alert IDs: https://www.zaproxy.org/docs/alerts/
# --- Triaged from the 2026-09-10 unauthenticated baseline of Wayfinder.ReferenceApp ---
# Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens — the unauthenticated login form only. A pre-auth login
# form has no session to protect with a synchroniser token; every POST form behind auth
# carries __RequestVerificationToken via Wayfinder.Engine.Http's WayfinderAntiforgery.
# Scoped (Phase 3c, authenticated scan): a blanket IGNORE here would have silently hidden
# a real finding on an authenticated form.
# CSP style-src 'unsafe-inline' — required: @xyflow/react (the editor canvas) injects
# <style> elements at runtime, so no nonce or hash can cover them. script-src has NO
# 'unsafe-inline' and NO 'unsafe-eval'. Revisit if the editor drops React Flow, or if
# dast.yml starts serving a per-route CSP (strict on the GOV.UK pages, relaxed on /editor).
# Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy missing — COEP: require-corp exists only to enable
# cross-origin isolation (SharedArrayBuffer, high-resolution timers), which this host
# does not use. On its own it does nothing (isolation also needs COOP: same-origin,
# which the middleware does set). Enabling it would just impose a strict opt-in gate on
# every present and future subresource for no security benefit. Not a vulnerability —
# ZAP flags the header's absence generically.

column4: COEP only matters for cross-origin isolation, which this host does not use
